interface.longDescription: Aetheria Online runs persistent fantasy RPG campaigns set inside a detailed full-dive VRMMORPG. Start on Launch Day, six months later, or during the first anniversary, then enter Aetheria through an in-world character-creation sequence with playable species, lineages and four starter centres. The simulator tracks continuity, relationships, injuries, politics, travel, languages, organisations, rumours and consequences while NPCs and institutions act independently of the player. Campaigns use detailed chapter-like narration and end at meaningful decisions with context-sensitive action suggestions while always allowing freeform actions.
